text: Vantrel, Jan. 18 — The Vantry maglev prototype reached a top recorded speed of 540 km/h during a December test run on the Alder Loop track, people familiar with the matter said. The run, conducted on Dec. 14, was logged by engineers from Helix Transit Systems and observed by regulators from the Traven Motion Authority, according to the people. The prototype held the speed for 11.6 seconds before beginning a controlled deceleration, they said. Officials are reviewing thermal data and vibration readings ahead of a second high-speed trial scheduled for late February. The Vantry program is intended to inform future intercity service between Vantrel and North Quay.
